'''Gizz's Gang''',<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> commonly referred to as '''Jabba's swoop gang'''<ref name="SotESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> was a motley [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in the employ of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 
==Background==
The members of the gang were ruffians picked up among criminals, thugs and other [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrels]] found in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]; some were recruited just for their talent in [[swooper/Legends|swooping]] and some were burned-out [[Swoop racing/Legends|racers]], some were outlaws dumped on Tatooine and had nothing better to do. They were hired to do errands between Mos Eisley and [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]], causing havoc, racing among the dunes of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],[[racketeering|collecting "taxes"]] from [[Merchant/Legends|shopkeepers]] and [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]], and bringing reports from the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]]. Sometimes they escorted the Hutt or one of his officials between [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his Palace]] and the [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|townhouse]]. They spent the nights getting drunk and harrassing folk in the cantinas. The sense of freedom, "authority", access to speedy vehicles and weapons, were always appealing to thugs, ensuring that they always wanted in.<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The Hutt was often annoyed by the gang riding their speeders inside the corridors of his palace; not only they abused his servants, but they were disrespectful, resulting to threats from Jabba, and using an occasional gang member to feed his [[rancor/Legends|rancor]].<ref name="sotesb" />
==History==
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the gang of a dozen was led by [[Gizman]]. [[Spiker]] was Gizz's right hand man (and secretly Jabba's [[spy/Legends|spy]], reporting excess profits that Gizz doesn't mention to the Hutt) and the two kept the chaotic ruffians in line. Another member under Gizman was [[Axeman]].<ref name="sotesb" />

They recruited [[Wrenga Jixton|Jix]], a "fellow biker"/[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spy, in Mos Eisley, who joined them in an [[Beggar's Canyon Incident|encounter]] against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Jix double-crossed them, hired by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to protect Luke, and left Gizz for dead.<ref>[[Shadows of the Empire 4|''Shadows of the Empire'' 4]]</ref> Later Spiker was shot in the attempt to retrieve [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] carbonized body from [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref>[[Shadows of the Empire 6|''Shadows of the Empire'' 6]]</ref>

After Jabba's death, Gizz and Spiker were reunited. Having stolen a ship from Jabba's palace following the Rebel operation on Tatooine, Gizz and Spiker were almost killed by a deadly security device Jabba had installed onboard the craft, which turned out to be his personal treasure ship. After they crash-landed the ship, and escaped with their lives, the bikers left to find civilization in the company of [[Onoh]], who had been guarding the ship.

==Equipment==
The swoopers are equipped with modified swoop bikes and are generally seen wearing [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] and tall protective shock helmets, earning the nickname "conedomes" among the Tatooinian settlers. They were armed with [[blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and melee weapons such as hidden daggers, pipes and [[vibro-ax/Legends|vibroaxes]].<ref name="sotesb" />

Their clothes were highly customized, but they all carried Jabba's [[:File:Desilijic_clan_vector.svg|pronged symbol]] stitched (or even [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]]). Many wore freighter work suits, but generally their appearance varied, from blue [[neocelk]]s and tan [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suits]] to [[Jumpsuit/Legends|coveralls]] with green puff sleeves or red-dyed tunics from [[bantha/Legends|bantha]] skin.<ref name="sotesb" />
==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Most of them will turn out to be fodder for Luke and Dash, but two to note are Spiker, who wears so many spikes youmight mistake him for a porcupine, and Big Gizz, the leader, who's about 6'9", hairy and shaggy, with bones through his ears or nose (or both) and a face like Jaws form the bond film.|[[John Wagner]]'s description of the Gang for the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' (comic series)]]|<ref name="secrets">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>}}
The swoop gang is featured in all media of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project. It was inspired by the "conehead" swoop bikers designed by [[Industrial Light & Magic|Industrial Light and Magic]] for the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|special edition]] of {{Film|4}}. In most media, they are faceless and nameless, but the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|comic series]] fleshes out their background, and some of the individual members.<ref name="secrets" />

In the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|video game]] they feature the "conehead" appearance,<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire video game">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref> and a "conehead" also appears in the cover of [[Shadows of the Empire 3|the third issue]] of the comic series, drawn by [[Hugh Fleming]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 3">[[Shadows of the Empire 3|''Shadows of the Empire'' 3]]</ref>
